prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website comp variation C for PawFriend, 1536x1024 first viewport plus the start of the next section
Input image: use the attached Good Paws page only for the approved visual language: oversized rescue pet photography, warm paper, condensed typography, playful annotations, and bold editorial color fields. Do not copy the logo or exact layout.
Primary request: Create an image-first PawFriend pet shelter landing-page hero in a tactile adoption zine and portrait-studio contact-sheet world.
Structure: slim warm-paper navigation with black PawFriend wordmark and simple links; the hero is split horizontally, with the upper 72% dominated by a full-bleed close rescue-dog portrait cropped from the chest upward against a dusty pink field, the dog's head breaking into the navigation margin; a compact warm-paper headline block overlaps the lower-left of the photograph and reads 'FIND YOUR PERSON.' in enormous compressed black type, two lines maximum; beneath it, one-line supporting copy 'Big personalities. Small bios. One very good reason to meet.' and an ink-black CTA 'MEET THE PETS'; a fluorescent lime painted underline and a handwritten annotation 'Milo — certified sock thief'; the lower 28% becomes an orange editorial ticker with '312 personalities are waiting' at left and five contact-print resident portraits emerging to the right, names MILO, LUNA, PEPPER, OTIS, NORI. Show a small start of the next warm-paper section below.
Visual world: warm off-white recycled paper, ink black, dusty pink, rescue orange, fluorescent lime, pale sky blue used sparingly. Hard seams, cut-paper overlap, taped photo edges, little to no radius, no glass, no gradients.
Typography: dramatic ultra-compressed black display plus clean grotesk body and handwritten ink notes.
Composition: cinematic but unmistakably a usable website, one dominant pet, generous negative space, clear action readable on a small laptop.
Motion cues implied: photo mask expands on load; resident contact prints glide laterally as the orange strip enters.
Constraints: readable real UI text, realistic shelter pet photography, accessible contrast, no awards, no testimonials, no generic cards, no extra pills, no random blobs, no watermark.
